origins.name: Unpaid Hulls

origins.name: Shift Wrecks
origins.origin: Tugs that missed the union bell and were left between shifts.

origins.name: Cut Purses
origins.origin: Dispatch boats robbed between Guest Lamp stations and never claimed.

origins.name: Abandoned Help
origins.origin: Rescue boats the navy recalled when the call was two lanes off Orbit Only.

origins.name: Burned Beacons
origins.origin: Municipal beacons the parish burned after the navy went home.

origins.name: Morning After
origins.origin: Deals that failed when the navy came back and towed the stalls.

origins.name: Confiscated Holds
origins.origin: Living cargo taken at Coda and parked until a warden burns the manifest.

origins.name: Burned Domes
origins.origin: Domes the Choir fired after the moth count failed.

origins.name: Lost Drones
origins.origin: Harvest drones the blight sealed shut and the Choir refused to tow.

origins.name: Glassed Sheds
origins.origin: Farm sheds glassed in the hymn and left as a warning.

origins.name: Dirty Holds
origins.origin: Holds the Choir emptied because the gloves were not clean.

origins.name: Revoked Samples
origins.origin: Samples the license revoked and the shard would not burn on site.

origins.name: Wrong Lane
origins.origin: Tows that followed the chart and arrived in the gravel instead of the lane.

origins.name: Compartment Spill
origins.origin: Compartments that opened when the station hulk rolled.

origins.name: Unanswered
origins.origin: Calls the last buoy logged and no ship answered.

origins.name: Expired Papers
origins.origin: Privateers whose paper died at Step and whose hulls stayed.

origins.name: Dishonored
origins.origin: Captains who presented a letter at Marque Rock and were fired on anyway.

origins.name: Starved Convoys
origins.origin: Food convoys that were eaten before they docked at Tithe Outpost.

origins.name: Costume Hulls
origins.origin: Hulls painted Compact and abandoned when the real cutter did not come.

origins.name: Frozen Claims
origins.origin: Homesteads frozen by raids and towed here to be stripped.

origins.name: No Log
origins.origin: Fights that ended here and were never written into a Compact log.

origins.name: Unpaid Tribute
origins.origin: Hulls that reached Quay and would not pay.

origins.name: Trusted Wrong
origins.origin: Captains who heaved to for a stolen Choir beacon.

origins.name: Sealed Then Stolen
origins.origin: Vaults lifted from Sealed Orchard and cracked at Seedcut.

origins.name: Undecided
origins.origin: Hulls that would not pick a sail at Twin Wake.

origins.name: Thrown Out
origins.origin: Captains the den threw out the hollow and did not tow home.

origins.name: First Deaths
origins.origin: Couriers who believed the plywood was a Compact fort.
